requirements.requirement: Lens mutation cannot alter canonical RAPP/1 envelope semantics.
requirements.control: Host verifies source application content and independently constructs/signs successor Frames.

requirements.requirement: Existing Workspace/1, Hive/1, and Federation/1 bytes remain unchanged.
requirements.control: Separate versioned profile with exact sibling pins.

requirements.requirement: Wild-handshake and both hotload agents are exact bytes.
requirements.control: Bindings and fixture inventory pin SHA-256 and byte count.

requirements.requirement: The generic CEO agent and Skill must be exact bytes and presence must grant no authority.
requirements.control: Verified agent/Skill pins, deterministic implementation binding, external-host-only activation, and tamper mutants.

requirements.requirement: Normal fallback uses a deterministic static agent with zero model calls.
requirements.control: Generated bytes, generation receipt, and runtime output record zero model calls.

requirements.requirement: Incomplete Hive compatibility is useful but never presented as complete membership.
requirements.control: Per-capability statuses, integer coverage, explicit gaps, and authority false.

requirements.requirement: Every package byte and successor occurrence is inventoried.
requirements.control: Closed regular-file manifest and complete reverse lineage.
Independent host/canonical tests and controlled mutants are mandatory.

requirements.requirement: User corrections cannot be dropped, forged, or replaced by assistant proposals.
requirements.control: Hash-chained typed learning trace and correction closure.

requirements.requirement: No raw transcript, native session, local path, token, credential, or private source payload is persisted.
requirements.control: Sanitized commitments and fixture privacy scan.

requirements.requirement: Replay, rollback, same-sequence fork, signature substitution, and revoked mappings fail closed.
requirements.control: RAPP frame verification, immutable pins, and successor causality.
Hard lens/candidate/cross/depth/round/beam/Pareto ceilings and root stop reasons.

requirements.requirement: PR/merge transport does not activate or rewrite an ancestor.
UniversalDataConnectorAI is provenance, not trusted code or RAPP conformance.
requirements.control: Exact upstream commit/blob record and explicit excluded mechanisms.

requirements.requirement: Duplicate keys, floats, unknown fields, and unsafe paths are not repaired.
requirements.control: Strict parser, closed schema, canonical bytes, and safe relative paths.
